messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT - P2: CI & packaging failures affecting hotfix pipelines. Paging Alice (oncall).

Alice (oncall): on call. quick summary pls.

Tom: multiple build jobs failing in GH Actions when provisioning runners. Errors like `Failed to create runner: 502` and `API rate limit exceeded`. Workflows stuck at `actions/checkout` or runner provisioning.

Lina: during the build we're also seeing 502/503 from npm registry for fetches. Several `npm ci` steps time out. Some steps fallback to our internal npm proxy but not all packages are cached -> build fails.

Norman: tried web UI -> re-run job -> instant fail `Repository not found` (weird). suspecting GitHub API throttling or degraded package registry. Self-hosted runners still alive but most workflows target `github-hosted` label.

Alice (oncall): do we have any hotfixes blocked right now? customer impact?

Tom: yes. A customer-facing security hotfix PR is merged to branch and waiting for CI to produce image so we can deploy. Can't create the image without CI.

Lina: workarounds: 1) run the same workflow on self-hosted runners (if jobs are compatible) 2) build locally and push artifact to internal registry (S3/ECR) 3) rollback to previous image if can't produce artifact quickly.

Alice (oncall): pick fastest. Norman, can you flip workflow to use self-hosted label? If not, Tom/Mike do local build.

Norman: attempting to edit workflow dispatch now to use `self-hosted:linux` runner. Will trigger manual run.

Tom: starting local build in parallel. need deploy permissions to push to internal repo.

Alice (oncall): granting deploy role to Tom for the incident window. Also open support tickets with GitHub and npm. SupportBot, do your thing.

SupportBot: Created GitHub support case #GH-47211: "Actions runner provisioning and API errors affecting builds" - https://support.github.com/cases/47211. Created npm incident report #NPM-882 - https://status.npmjs.org/incidents/882.

OpsBot: Noted on-call escalation: if providers not responding in 45m, escalate to infra lead.

Tom: local build logs (tail):
```
> docker build -t redwood/hotfix:1782104567-local .
Step 1/12 : FROM node:18
Step 7/12 : RUN npm ci
GET https://registry.npmjs.org/left-pad 502 (retrying)
Using mirror-cache.internal/left-pad -> OK
Pushed to registry.internal.redwood/hotfix:1782104567-local
```

Tom: pushed artifact to internal registry. Requesting deploy: `/deploy promote registry.internal.redwood/hotfix:1782104567-local --env=prod`

deploy-bot: Promotion queued. Starting canary rollout (1/5 pods).

Lina: self-hosted runner job started after label change. It used our cached npm mirror and completed successfully. CI logs show `artifact upload` succeeded and checksum matches. Suggest enabling mirror in more workflows.

Alice (oncall): good. run smoke tests on canary. Norman, coordinate customer comms about the temporary manual deploy.

Norman: canary smoke -> OK. No regression. Starting full rollout. deploy-bot: rollout 5/5 pods done.

Lina: some services do runtime on-demand installs, we should check those paths. But hotfix CI path is unblocked via self-hosted/local artifact.

SupportBot: GitHub status update: "Investigating: Actions API and runner provisioning issues" (https://www.githubstatus.com/incident/XYZ). npm status: "Partial outages in registry GET endpoints" (https://status.npmjs.org/). Support case GH-47211 updated - GitHub acknowledging API degradation.

Alice (oncall): marking incident as mitigated (manual artifact + self-hosted CI). Root cause external. Keep monitors for 30m.

Tom: suggested permanent actions: - mark critical hotfix workflows with self-hosted fallback labels - maintain 72h last-known-good artifacts for each service - configure CI to use internal npm mirror when registry responses degrade - add pipeline logic to fallback to artifact-store on build failures caused by 5xx from external services

Lina: will own postmortem. I'll include timeline, impact, decision tree, and action items. ETA 48h.

Norman: informed PMs and support team. Customer notified about temporary deploy route.

Alice (oncall): handoff in 20m to Norman. If anything flares, @alice. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup: :eyes: 

incident-bot: Incident note: mitigated at 1782104830. Workaround: manual artifact builds + self-hosted CI. Postmortem owner: Lina.

SupportBot: Final update from GitHub: ongoing investigation, no ETA. npm indicates partial recovery; some endpoints returning 200s now.

Alice (oncall): closing page but keeping a watch for 30m. If providers fully recover, we revert back to normal CI.

Norman: ack, taking over monitoring.

Alice (oncall): thanks all.
